notes.title: Dev Archives: A Look into Pearl Abyss’ BlackSpace Engine
notes.content:
[h2]2025 Game Developers Conference Recap[/h2]

[previewyoutube=WEBAgTozBEU;full][/previewyoutube]
(Footage in the above video was captured in-engine and may differ from the final game.)
[h3]Behind closed doors at this year's GDC, we revealed a peek into the engine behind Crimson Desert - Pearl Abyss’ in-house BlackSpace Engine. Here are just a few of the details the engine makes possible in-game to breathe life into the land of Pywel![/h3]
[h3]Watch those details come to life. Seeing is believing as they say.[/h3]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343476/8b0ec3dc376e958943b5fff715f4846882796259.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Immersive Details Both Big and Small[/b][/h3]
[b]Shallow Water Feature[/b]
 [code]The BlackSpace Engine steps up the realism in water flow and tides by simulating collision with the environment through the Shallow Water feature. [/code] 
[b]Volumetric Fog with Fluid Simulation[/b]
 [code]Volumetric fog with fluid simulation adds an eerie touch to this environment as the fog reacts to every step, hop, and roll.[/code]
[b]Timelapse (Atmospheric Scattering)[/b]
 [code]Good morning, afternoon, evening, and night! The day and night cycle running in tune with real-time lighting and detailed atmospheric scattering brings another layer of realism to the world.[/code] 
[b]GPU-based Cloth and Hair Simulation[/b]
 [code]Any way the wind blows, cloth and hair will flutter and sway in a natural and familiar way. [/code]
[b]Raytracing[/b]
 [code]The engine's real-time lighting calculations enable realistic looking surroundings with Raytracing off but enhance your surroundings even further with Raytracing on. [/code]
[img]https://s1.pearlcdn.com/crimsondesert/staticUpload/Board/9a1a602d94d20241213062002770.png[/img]
